glance.en: They only have time for a glance. A glance at something means a quick look.
glance.zh: 他们只有时间瞥一眼。瞥一眼某物意味着快速看一眼。

glance.en: They only have time for a glance. A glance at something means a quick look.
glance.zh: 他们只有时间瞥一眼。瞥一眼某物意味着快速看一眼。

glance.en: The phrase at first glance means looking at something for the first time, before having a chance to look more carefully.
glance.zh: 短语“乍一看”是指第一次看某物，在有机会仔细观察之前。

glance.en: At first glance, William sees only junk.
However, a quick glance at social media revealed the ultimate source of the email and the potential consequences of not responding.
glance.zh: 然而，大致浏览一下社交媒体就会发现这封邮件的最终来源以及不回复的潜在后果。

global.en: But there are also some global forces, factors that affect the global property market.
global.zh: 但也有一些全球性的力量，即影响全球房地产市场的因素。

global.en: But there are also some global forces, factors that affect the global property market.
global.zh: 但也有一些全球性的力量，即影响全球房地产市场的因素。

global.en: And in fact, this year’s Global Happiness Report made this sensation a core focus.
global.zh: 事实上，今年的《全球幸福报告》将这种感受作为核心关注点。

global.en: So that global army of investment managers was hungrier and twitchier than ever before.
global.zh: 因此，全球的那支投资经理大军比以往任何时候都更加饥渴、更加焦躁不安。

global.en: But first, our quiz question. World leaders promised in 2015 to limit global temperature rises.
global.zh: 但首先，是我们的问答环节。世界领导人在 2015 年承诺限制全球气温上升。

glory.en: For glory? For loyalty to a ruler they would almost certainly never meet?
glory.zh: 为了荣誉？为了效忠一个他们几乎肯定永远不会见面的统治者？

glory.en: The Moissy, as you might imagine, do not cover themselves in glory.
glory.zh: 正如你所能想象的那样，“Moissy”民兵并没有建立什么光彩的功勋。

glory.en: Exploration was the ultimate frontier, and it promised fortune, glory, and the chance to write your name into history.
glory.zh: 探索是终极的前沿，它承诺带来财富、荣耀，以及将你的名字写入历史的机会。

glory.en: He had temples erected to his own glory, with priests appointed to offer sacrifices to him as though he were Jupiter.
glory.zh: 他为自己的荣耀建造了神庙，并指定祭司向他献祭，仿佛他就是 Jupiter。

glory.en: The aim is to break world records. In fact, some of these competitors are former Olympians – medallists battling it out for money and glory.
glory.zh: 目的是打破世界纪录。事实上，其中一些参赛者是前奥运选手——奖牌得主们为了金钱和荣耀展开对决。

glove.en: A glove puppet, on the other hand, sits directly on the performer's hand.
glove.zh: 相比之下，手套木偶（glove puppet）直接套在表演者的手上。

glove.en: Whatsmore, glove puppets move in a completely different way to marionettes.
glove.zh: 不仅如此，手套木偶的运动方式与提线木偶完全不同。

glove.en: Well, strangely enough, it all comes down to leather gloves.
glove.zh: 说来奇怪，这一切都归结于皮手套。

glove.en: Right, I'm off to find my gloves and woolly hat, so why don't you reveal the answer to the question, Phil?
glove.zh: 好了，我要去找我的手套和羊毛帽了，那么 Phil，你何不揭晓那个问题的答案呢？

glove.en: So, local artisans began scenting the gloves with floral extracts to mask the unpleasant odour, to hide the nasty smell.
glove.zh: 因此，当地的工匠开始用花卉提取物给手套加香，以掩盖难闻的气味，隐藏刺鼻的臭味。

glamour.en: For the great explorers, the glamour of risk and discovery, at least for European eyes.
glamour.zh: 对于那些伟大的探险家来说，至少在欧洲人眼中，魅力在于冒险和发现本身。

glamour.en: Jayne uses the adjective glam as a shortened form of the word, glamour, meaning attractive and exciting.
glamour.zh: 杰恩用形容词 glam 作为 glamour（迷人、激动人心）的缩写，意思是迷人和吸引人。

glamour.en: But for the Internet, the glamour is the money.
glamour.zh: 但对于互联网来说，魅力就是金钱。

gloomy.en: But it's been a really tough year. It's been really gloomy for them.
gloomy.zh: 但这一年真的很艰难。对他们来说实在是太阴暗了。

gloomy.en: Hardly surprising, perhaps. Another tracked changes in national mood based on how cheerful or gloomy song lyrics became over the course of decades.
gloomy.zh: 这或许并不令人意外。另一项研究则根据几十年间歌曲歌词变得欢快还是沮丧，来追踪国家情绪的变化。

globe.en: Adventurers from around the globe tried to retrace Fawcett’s steps.
globe.zh: 世界各地的冒险家都试图重走 Fawcett 的足迹。

globe.en: Changi Airport connects the city to destinations across the globe.
globe.zh: 樟宜机场将这座城市与全球各地的目的地连接起来。

globe.en: But you could also develop other interests, and for some, this took the form of a fascination with distant corners of the globe.
globe.zh: 但你也可以培养其他兴趣，对某些人来说，这种兴趣表现为对地球遥远角落的迷恋。

globe.en: Seats for temporary members are shared between different regions of the world, so that every part of the globe has a chance to be represented.
globe.zh: 非常任理事国的席位在世界不同地区之间分配，以便全球各个角落都有机会获得代表权。

gleam.en: What's beautiful about it, of course, is that since that gleam in his eye, the price of a cell phone has fallen dramatically, and per capita income in Bangladesh has gone through the roof.
gleam.zh: 当然，美妙之处在于，自从他脑子里冒出那个念头以来，手机价格已经大幅下降，孟加拉国的人均收入也一路飙升。

glimpse.en: I think of myself as a researcher. I've always, like when the internet came along, anything that I'm interested in, I'll go forever. going deeper and deeper and deeper into a topic just to get any glimpse and to read opposing opinions and go deeper and deeper and deeper and just try and understand.
glimpse.zh: 我把自己看作一名研究者。我一直都是这样，比如当互联网出现时，任何我感兴趣的东西，我都会钻研到底。不断深入、深入、再深入地挖掘一个话题，只为了窥见一斑，去阅读对立的观点，不断深入，只是为了尝试去理解。

glorious.en: Yeah, a lot of it is just you're memeing yourself into a bad outcome because you think that somehow suffering is glorious or that it makes you a better person or you know my old quip was if you're so smart why aren't you happy why can't you figure that one out um the reality is you can be smart and happy there are plenty of people in human history who are smart and happy and i think it just starts with saying yeah you know what i'm gonna be happy there was a guy that i met in thailand a long time ago and uh he used to work for tony robbins uh you know he had great attitude.
glorious.zh: 是的，很多时候你只是在用迷因（meme）心态把自己忽悠到一个糟糕的结果里，因为你觉得吃苦在某种程度上是光彩的，或者它能让你成为一个更好的人，你知道我的老笑话是：如果你那么聪明，为什么你还不快乐？为什么你想不通这一点？嗯，现实是你可以既聪明又快乐，人类历史上有很多聪明又快乐的人，我认为这一切都始于这样一句话：“是的，你知道吗，我要快乐。”很久以前我在泰国遇到过一个人，呃，他以前给托尼·罗宾斯（Tony Robbins）工作过，你知道的，他心态极好。

glue.en: These artisans who do it. But they don't just glue it back together. they glue it back together and they sort of adorn it with like a golden bondage.
glue.zh: 那些工匠会这样做。但他们不仅仅是用胶水粘回去，他们用金漆来修补裂缝。

glue.en: These artisans who do it. But they don't just glue it back together. they glue it back together and they sort of adorn it with like a golden bondage.
glue.zh: 那些工匠会这样做。但他们不仅仅是用胶水粘回去，他们用金漆来修补裂缝。
